image_manifest.description: An asset manifest for a stylized 3D rendered scene of three unique racing marine reptiles lined up in the water at a floating buoy starting line with a human referee.

assets.name: Header Text
assets.description: Blue and yellow, stylized, irregular 3D block text reading 'RACING MARINE REPTILES!' located at the top of the image.

assets.name: Mosasaurus Racer Character
assets.description: A powerful Mosasaurus treading water behind the ribbon line on the left, its large head bobbing out of the sea with expressive, soulful eyes and a determined expression, showing a glimpse of its patterned, dark leathery skin just below the surface.

assets.name: Elasmosaurus Racer Character
assets.description: A long-necked Plesiosaur (Elasmosaurus) positioned in the center, its head raised high out of the water on its curved neck, looking down over the starting ribbon with intense, playful competitive focus.

assets.name: Ichthyosaurus Racer Character
assets.description: A sleek, dolphin-like Ichthyosaurus on the right, its snout breaking through the water's surface as it rapidly bobs in place, ready to instantly burst forward into a swim.

assets.name: Human Referee Character
assets.description: dino_bones_paleontologist_4 (an adult male Latino grad student with short brown hair, wearing signature thin-rimmed BLACK aviator lens glasses) acting as the race official. He is sitting on a small floating platform on the far right, wearing a black-and-white vertical striped referee jersey with a silver whistle hanging from a necklace.

assets.name: Racing Flag Item
assets.description: A bright green racing flag attached to a short pole, held high and being waved actively through the air by dino_bones_paleontologist_4 to signify the start of the race.

assets.name: Floating Buoy Starting Line Environment
assets.description: A vibrant red starting line ribbon pulled taut over the surface of the water, anchored securely between two large, round, floating orange-and-white aquatic buoys.

assets.name: Epicontinental Seaway Marine Environment
assets.description: Set in the shallow, sunlit turquoise-to-cobalt waters of the EPICONTINENTAL_SEAWAY formation, featuring high surface visibility, gentle water ripples catching refractive light, white sea spray, and drifting bubbles around the racers beneath an open, vibrant-blue sky.

assets.name: Bottom Right Watermark
assets.description: A small, translucent lens-flare type logo/watermark located in the bottom-right corner.
